brand.title: Make sense of your investing history.

points.fund: Your portfolio is priced like a fund; adding or withdrawing money doesn't distort returns.
points.compare: Compare against BIST 100, gold and the dollar for every period.

auth.secureNote: Your connection is encrypted; your password is only stored as an irreversible hash.

analyze.subtitle: Average cost method · prices exclude today · dividends net of withholding tax · commission included

hints.unit: Like a fund chart: the unit price moves with the stocks you held on each day. Green dot = period high, red dot = low; the shaded area is the largest drawdown. Dashed lines show the same money in BIST 100, gold and the dollar. BIST 100 is a price index (excludes dividends); gold is derived from the gold future and the dollar rate.
hints.value: Total value (holdings + cash in the safe) against the money you brought in from outside (dashed).
hints.pl: Cumulative profit/loss on each day: realized + unrealized + dividends.

chart.noData: No historical performance data available for this period.
chart.portfoliosHint: Portfolio lines show each portfolio's own unit price from its first buy (or the range start), starting from the combined unit price that day. One ending above the combined line did better than the whole over that time.

analyze.dividendsHint: Credited on the ex-date to shares held the day before, net of withholding tax, into the safe.

warnings.title: Some market data could not be loaded. Results may be incomplete.
warnings.market_data_unavailable: Market data for {{ticker}} could not be refreshed; the last stored data is shown.
warnings.rights_issue_review: A rights issue for {{ticker}} needs review; enter or confirm its terms in the Rights Issues section of the Transactions page.
warnings.fund_prices_outdated: Uploaded fund prices for {{ticker}} are missing or out of date; upload a fresh TEFAS Excel in the Fund Prices section of the Transactions page.

performance.returnHint: Time-weighted return: performance of your holdings, not affected by when you added money.
performance.drawdownHint: Largest fall from a high point to a later low, measured on the time-weighted return.
performance.notRecovered: Not recovered yet · now {{value}} from peak

analyze.loading: Updating market data; the first open of the day can take a few seconds…

empty.title: No trades to analyze yet
empty.description: Add your first buy to see the portfolio's fund-style chart, returns and per-stock profit/loss.

fund.unitPriceHint: Your portfolio is priced like a mutual fund: it starts at 1.0000 and moves only with performance. Adding or withdrawing money doesn't move the unit price.

returns.title: Returns
returns.hint: Return: unit price change over the period picked on the chart; adding or withdrawing money doesn't affect it. Same money: your P/L today had each amount you put in bought these instead of stocks, on the same days.
returns.volatilityHint: Annualized standard deviation of daily returns; the higher, the bumpier the ride.
returns.sameMoneyHint: From the start until today: each time money came into the portfolio, the same TL amount is bought at that day's close. The portfolio row is your actual total P/L. BIST 100 is a price index (no dividends).

positions.title: Profit / Loss by Stock
positions.hint: Unrealized: today's gain on shares still held. Realized: gains locked in by selling (incl. sold rights). For closed stocks, quantity is the shares sold and price shows average cost → average sale price. Commissions included.
positions.closedPricesHint: Shares sold; average cost → average sale price (commission included, in the split basis of the day it closed).

insights.title: Highlights
insights.hint: What the charts and tables say, from the start until today.

daily.hint: Unit price change at the {{date}} close vs. the previous trading day

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: All your portfolios as one fund: total size, profit/loss and return. Experimental portfolios are not included.
overview.loadError: Could not load the analysis of: {{names}}
overview.footnote: The unit price and returns are computed from the portfolios' combined daily value, with the effect of new money removed.

empty.title: Nothing to summarize yet
empty.description: The Overview adds up your portfolios that have trades. Create a portfolio and add its first buy.
empty.allExperimental: All of your portfolios with trades are marked experimental. Unmark the ones you want in the Overview from My Portfolios.

table.title: Profit / Loss by Portfolio
table.hint: Each portfolio's size (cash included), share of the total, money put in and P/L split. Unit price return is performance without the effect of new money.

insights.noWinner: No portfolio is in profit yet.

public.label: Public
public.description: Everyone sees it on Explore, as percentages only. Amounts and trades stay hidden.

experimental.label: Experimental
experimental.description: A trial or paper portfolio. It keeps its own analysis but is left out of the Overview.

delete.title: Delete portfolio
delete.description: The portfolio and all its trades are deleted for good.

explore.amountsHidden: Amounts are hidden; only percentages are shown.
explore.amountsHiddenDetail: Amounts and trades are hidden. The unit price starts at 1.0000 and shows performance without the effect of new money.
explore.notFound: This portfolio was not found or is no longer public.

empty.title: No public portfolios yet

explore.returnsHint: Unit price change over the period picked on the chart; adding or withdrawing money does not move it. Below: BIST 100, gold and the dollar over the same period.

rightsIssues.title: Rights Issues
rightsIssues.hint: Yahoo doesn't report rights issues; it silently lowers earlier prices instead. For every rights issue listed here, past prices are restored to their real values. If you exercised your rights use "Exercised", if you sold them use "Sold"; if you did nothing, no transaction is needed.
rightsIssues.empty: No rights issues recorded for this portfolio's stocks.

form.title: Add Rights Issue
form.hint: Take the details from the capital increase announcement on KAP.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete Rights Issue
deleteConfirm.message: The {{date}} rights issue of {{ticker}} will be deleted. It affects every portfolio holding the stock; past prices go back to Yahoo's lowered values.

fundPrices.title: Fund Prices
fundPrices.hint: Yahoo has no daily prices for funds. On TEFAS, open Fund Data, pick the fund and a date range, download the Excel and upload it here. Re-upload now and then to stay current; a new file is merged with the old one.
fundPrices.empty: No funds yet. Add a buy first, then upload its prices.

form.title: Upload TEFAS Prices
form.hint: TEFAS → Fund Data → pick the fund → Excel. Prices are shared by every portfolio holding the fund.
